description: Source code for the CanvasController class, which manages a WebView for rendering canvases, taking snapshots, and updating debug status within an Android application.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: Manages interactions with a WebView to render, snapshot, and update status of a canvas in an Android app.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Associates a WebView with the controller and initializes display, debug status, and state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Removes the WebView reference from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Loads a specific URL into the WebView.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL corresponds to the default scaffold.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Updates debug and canvas state after a page load completes.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON representing the home canvas state.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code on the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Takes a PNG snapshot of the WebView content and encodes it in Base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Takes a snapshot in specified format and quality, returning a Base64 string.
